title: ABA memory hazard in lockless lock-free queue head pointer recycling under high thread preemption
problem_statement:
### Issue FRONTIER-GH-0097: ABA memory hazard in lockless lock-free queue head pointer recycling under high thread preemption
Repository: `python/cpython`
Category: `Concurrency & Lockless Race Conditions`
Target File: `lockless_queue.c`

#### Problem Description
atomic_compare_exchange_weak with acquire-release fence fails when recycled node address matches ABA sequence.
Under high-load production execution, this defect triggers silent data corruption, deadlock, or assertion failure.

#### Concurrency & Invariant Conditions
- Precondition: Invariant validation must be enforced on physical silicon.
- Failure Mode: Reproduction fails with exit code != 0 or thread hang.
- Expected Fix Invariant: CAS loop must incorporate 64-bit epoch generation counter to ensure tag uniqueness.

#### Reproduction Target
Run: `pytest tests/test_frontier-gh-0097.py -q`
expected_invariant: CAS loop must incorporate 64-bit epoch generation counter to ensure tag uniqueness.
